races.paceDynamic: Pippin's Legend will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, likely setting a steady but not punishing tempo over this extended trip. With multiple prominent runners (Planters Punch, Crack Ops, Mistral St Georges, Masterfield) likely to track closely behind, the pace should be honest but manageable, setting up the race for either a sustained drive from the pace angle or a well-timed challenge from hold-up horses Saxons Pride and Molly's Lad.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners press Pippin's Legend from halfway and create a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will stretch the field and favor those with tactical speed who can travel strongly into the race. Crack Ops and Planters Punch are best positioned to capitalize on their proven ability at this trip and going.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Pippin's Legend gets an easy lead and the pace becomes steady throughout
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a sprint finish where the hold-up horses can unleash their turn of foot. Saxons Pride's class advantage becomes decisive with his proven ability to quicken off a strong pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Pippin's Legend gets uncontested early fractions and the field fails to close the gap
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back despite his modest rating. His previous placing at this going suggests he can handle the sustained effort required.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is overly conservative and multiple horses are still in contention at the last
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where the best horse on ratings can assert superiority. Saxons Pride's OR 120 becomes the determining factor in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Saxons Pride could be vulnerable if caught too far back given the small field size and potential lack of pace
Pippin's Legend's jumping under pressure — any mistakes when challenged could end his chance quickly
Planters Punch may face a wide trip if tracking the leader, potentially compromising his winning chance
Molly's Lad needs the pace to develop strongly to bring his finishing kick into play
Track Crack Ops for signs of confidence given his solid recent form and perfect going conditions

races.paceDynamic: Escort'kheops will be the uncontested leader with no other natural front runners in this field. This creates a sustainable galloping rhythm that should suit the prominent runners like Slim Marvel, Coumeenoole and Parliamo to track into contention, while the large contingent of hold-up horses (Daly Boy, Geordie Night, Golden Prince, Woodview Lad, Ocean Walz) will need the pace to collapse late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Escort'kheops Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains a steady rhythm and stays strong up the hill
scenarios.body: Escort'kheops dictates throughout and has enough left to repel late challengers. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses get first run on the leader turning for home
scenarios.body: Slim Marvel and Coumeenoole challenge Escort'kheops before the hill while hold-up horses are still making ground. The early move wins as closers run out of time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens enough in the middle stages to set up a closer
scenarios.body: One of the higher-rated hold-up horses times their run perfectly as the leaders tire. Daly Boy or Geordie Night produces a telling late surge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Parliamo Times It Right
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a tactical affair with a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The moderate pace suits Parliamo's prominent style to sit handy and quicken. Late runners get involved but the tactical speed wins.

watchPoints.text: Escort'kheops must be watched for early fluency as poor recent good ground form suggests he may not handle today's conditions
Slim Marvel and Coumeenoole need to be positioned close enough to strike before the climb as their styles require being handy
Daly Boy and Geordie Night require a strong enough gallop to set up their closing kicks over this staying trip
Golden Prince and Woodview Lad have limited good ground experience making their effectiveness on today's surface uncertain
Ocean Walz showed marked improvement on softer ground but today's firmer surface may not suit as well

races.paceDynamic: Roses All The Way will dictate terms from the front without serious pressure, creating a sustainable tempo that suits hold-up horses. With six runners showing hold-up tendencies and only Halftheworldaway likely to track the leader prominently, this sets up perfectly for closers to time their challenges in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits
scenarios.trigger: If Roses All The Way maintains an even gallop without serious pressure early
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get ideal conditions to unleash late kicks. Highland Haven and Halftheworldaway benefit most from the patient tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Roses All The Way kicks on approaching the final hurdle and gets first run
scenarios.body: The mare's recent staying form pays dividends as closers struggle to peg back her advantage. Halftheworldaway provides the main pursuit but falls short.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Novice Surprises Emerge
scenarios.trigger: If After The Ball or She Can Run show significantly improved form from their light racing
scenarios.body: One of the unknowns capitalizes on the steady pace to spring a major surprise. The experienced runners fail to cope with a fresh, improving talent.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying Test Bites
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the back straight onwards
scenarios.body: Seekingrainbows and Toni's Legacy find the strong pace over this longer trip beyond them. The classier staying types assert in a tough finish.

watchPoints.text: After The Ball and She Can Run are complete unknowns who could outrun their odds significantly if showing improvement
Highland Haven has failed to win in six attempts on similar going despite decent placed efforts
Roses All The Way needs to maintain her galloping rhythm over hurdles after recent jumping errors
Seekingrainbows has faded in both recent starts and may struggle if the pace becomes testing
The pace scenario heavily favors hold-up horses if Roses All The Way goes off steadily

races.paceDynamic: Bleu d'Enfer will set the early gallop alongside the prominently-raced Nativehill, Doyouknowwhatimean, Kahavari and The Good Doctor, creating a solid pace without being destructive. The large hold-up contingent of Anyharminasking, Busty Boy, Lady Jago, Palamon and Rule Me In will rely on the prominent runners maintaining a searching gallop to bring stamina into play over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favours Stamina
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain a solid searching pace throughout
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the strong gallop they need, with stamina becoming the decisive factor in the final half-mile. Anyharminasking and Busty Boy, both proven stayers with strong finishing kicks, can pick off the pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Control Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Bleu d'Enfer and the prominent group dictate a more measured early pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with the pace-setters able to kick clear before the hold-up horses can get into contention. Bleu d'Enfer's class and Doyouknowwhatimean's tactical speed prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration Splits Field
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the home turn onwards
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced horses with tactical pace can respond to the injection of speed while pure hold-up horses struggle to bridge the gap. Kahavari and The Good Doctor benefit from being closer to the pace when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too conservative with the prominent runners going too slowly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where early position matters less and raw speed dominates. Lady Jago's multiple course wins and Rule Me In's consistent finishing speed could surprise at bigger odds.

watchPoints.text: Bleu d'Enfer setting too strong an early pace that compromises his own stamina over this trip
Whether Nativehill shows any recent race fitness given the question marks over his latest form
The prominent runners going too slowly early and allowing the hold-up brigade to get into contention easily
How quickly Anyharminasking can get into the race from his hold-up position when the pace lifts
Lady Jago's jumping rhythm early as her holds-up style requires clean leaping to stay in touch

races.paceDynamic: Subtle Fortune will control this race as the only genuine front runner, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. Behind him, five prominent runners (Good Work, Felton Bellevue, Streamsforth Lad, Nine Nine Nine, I See The Sea, Pearl Island) will create serious congestion tracking the leader, setting up traffic problems and split-second decisions approaching the business end.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Subtle Fortune gets an easy lead and the prominent pack marks each other
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the chasers get in each other's way. His stamina from recent heavy ground wins proves decisive over this longer trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Catches Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners settle kindly and produce a coordinated challenge from 3 out
scenarios.body: The sustained pace tells on Subtle Fortune's solo effort as multiple challengers arrive together. The higher-rated prominent runners assert their class advantage in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and the prominent pack goes too hard too early
scenarios.body: Both leader and prominent runners empty their tanks, allowing The Scorpion King to sweep past tired horses with his superior rating. His hold-up style perfectly suits a collapse scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Subtle Fortune goes too slowly and the prominent runners fail to pressure him early enough
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence with tired legs all round. Lower-rated runners who conserved energy get competitive in a muddling finish.

watchPoints.text: Subtle Fortune must use his early advantage wisely as he lacks the class to win a driving finish against these
Traffic problems inevitable at crucial point with six horses wanting prominent positions behind lone leader
Three Zambezi's has finishing issues so any market support would be concerning given fading tendency
The Scorpion King needs a strong pace to set up his finish but may struggle if it becomes tactical
Good ground represents unknown territory for several runners despite generally positive going flags

races.paceDynamic: Morning Air will set an uncontested lead with Voodoo Angel tracking in second, creating a moderate gallop that favors the prominent runners. The five hold-up horses (Roaring Home, Service Minimum, Eastern Shores, Rock On Cassie, Nevershedatear) will need the pace to collapse in the final half-mile to have their chance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Morning Air and Voodoo Angel maintain their advantage turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows the leaders to kick clear while the hold-up brigade struggle to make ground. Morning Air's stamina tells despite her lower rating, with Voodoo Angel running into second.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from the third-last hurdle and creates gaps
scenarios.body: Service Minimum and Roaring Home use their superior ratings to power through a tiring field in the final furlong. The 103-105 OR horses assert their quality despite giving the leaders a head start.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If Eastern Shores gets the perfect trip tracking the pace in fourth or fifth
scenarios.body: Her consistent record at this trip allows her to pick up the pieces when the leaders tire and before the back markers arrive. Rock On Cassie could follow her through having raced more prominently than usual.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and becomes a sprint from the second-last
scenarios.body: Nevershedatear's fresh legs and good going preference allow her to exploit the chaos despite her low rating. The small field creates gaps that she can exploit late.

watchPoints.text: Morning Air gets a soft lead and isn't pressured by Voodoo Angel in the early stages
Service Minimum and Roaring Home get trapped behind a wall of horses turning for home
Eastern Shores positions herself closer to the pace than her usual hold-up style suggests
The pace quickens significantly from three out, potentially playing into the higher-rated horses' hands
Voodoo Angel tracks Morning Air too closely early and compromises her finishing kick
